slides.title: Gift shop owner, first week of November:
slides.body: Halloween is over. Holiday mode is on.

slides.label: Skeleton in the window:
slides.title: boxed up.
slides.body: Twinkle lights and a 'Now hiring for the holidays' sign: up.

slides.label: Seasonal hires:
slides.title: four new faces.
slides.body: Their new-hire paperwork finished before the first weekend rush: in progress.

slides.label: Holiday market booth:
slides.title: booked.
slides.body: The organizer wants our insurance certificate by Friday. The one we have expired in June.

slides.label: Year-end renewals:
slides.title: suddenly very close.
slides.body: Business license, seller's permit, the shop's insurance. Which one renews December 31st?

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: Do the paperwork switch in November. Sell in peace in December.
slides.body: Seasonal hire paperwork, event insurance certificates, license and permit renewal dates.
